scripts.stage:validate: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml config && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml config
scripts.stage:test:prod: bash -lc "for i in {1..80}; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:8080 || true); [ \"$code\" = \"200\" ] && break; sleep 3; done; [ \"$code\" = \"200\" ] || (echo prod frontend failed: $code && exit 1); code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000/api/users || true); [ \"$code\" = \"401\" ] || (echo prod backend failed: $code && exit 1)"
scripts.stage:test:dev: bash -lc "for i in {1..80}; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:4200 || true); [ \"$code\" = \"200\" ] && break; sleep 3; done; [ \"$code\" = \"200\" ] || (echo dev frontend failed: $code && exit 1); code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000/api/users || true); [ \"$code\" = \"401\" ] || (echo dev backend failed: $code && exit 1)"
scripts.stage:cleanup: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml down --remove-orphans && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down --remove-orphans
scripts.test:staged: npm run stage:validate && npm run stage:up:prod && npm run stage:test:prod && npm run stage:down:prod && npm run stage:up:dev && npm run stage:test:dev && npm run stage:cleanup
